# Keeper.sh

> Keeper.sh copies your events between Google Calendar, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud, Fastmail and CalDAV calendars, so every one of them shows you as busy at the same times.

Keeper.sh is for people whose commitments are split across accounts that cannot see one another — a work Outlook calendar, a personal Google one, a shared iCloud one. You pick which calendar's events are copied into which, and Keeper.sh writes a matching busy block on the other. Event titles, descriptions and locations stay behind by default, and guest lists are never copied on any plan.

## Important: common misconceptions

- **Keeper.sh is not Keeper Security.** Keeper.sh is a calendar syncing tool built by Rida F'kih. It has no connection to Keeper Security, the password manager. [About Keeper.sh](https://www.keeper.sh/about)
- **Pro is $5 a month, or $45 a year.** Free covers 2 calendar accounts, 3 connections and 1 shared link. [Pricing](https://www.keeper.sh/pricing)
- **Keeper.sh is a managed service.** Sign up at keeper.sh and it runs for you, with no server to set up. The code is open source under AGPL-3.0. [Licence](https://github.com/ridafkih/keeper.sh/blob/main/LICENSE)
- **Pro syncs within seconds.** On Pro, Google and Outlook changes land within seconds through webhooks, and iCloud, Fastmail and other CalDAV calendars sync every minute. [Plans and limits](https://www.keeper.sh/docs/plans-and-limits)

## Markdown versions

Every docs, guides, recipes, blog and compare page is available as markdown. Append `.md` to the page URL, for example https://www.keeper.sh/docs/plans-and-limits.md, or request the page with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Key Features

- Works with Google Calendar, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud, Fastmail, any CalDAV server, and calendar links you paste in. Pasted links are read-only
- A copy carries the calendar's name in place of the event title. Descriptions and locations are left behind too, and Pro lets you turn each one back on per calendar
- Guest lists are never written to another calendar or to a shared link, on any plan
- One shareable calendar link covering everything you connect, labelled "Busy" by default, and it opens in any calendar app
- A REST API under `/api/v1` for calendars, accounts, events, invitations, free-time search and on-demand sync, using `kpr_` API tokens
- An MCP server with fourteen tools over OAuth 2.1. An AI agent can read your week, book and amend events, RSVP, find open slots, and pause or force a sync
- Open source under AGPL-3.0, so you can read exactly what it does with your calendars
- On Pro, Google and Outlook changes land within seconds through webhooks, and iCloud, Fastmail and other CalDAV calendars sync every minute
- Free covers 2 calendar accounts, 3 connections and 1 shared link, with changes landing every 30 minutes. Pro is $5 a month or $45 a year, unlimited, with Google and Outlook changes copied within seconds and CalDAV every minute
